description: Replaces the branded terms of one Search Console property in Organiq (the list used by the brand filter, get_breakdown, get_branded_performance and the branded shape of analyze_query_shapes): brand and product names as people type them, up to 20 terms of 2–40 characters, lower-cased and de-duplicated; a query counts as branded when it contains one of them. The whole list is replaced (send the full list; [] clears). Takes effect immediately on the next read (no sync needed). Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it when check_connection lists no_branded_terms or brand=branded was rejected. / Substitui os termos de marca da propriedade (até 20); vale na hora.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

terms.description: Full list of branded terms (max 20, each 2–40 characters); [] clears.

name: set_branded_terms
title: Set the branded terms
